description: Warm, saturated, hand-placed 16-bit farming-sim pixel art. Top-down oblique view, dense decorative detail, hue-shifted shading, no pure black.

technical.dithering: none or minimal; texture comes from small hand-placed pixel clusters
technical.export: PNG, transparent background, spritesheet with no padding bleed

rules: show roof/top surface AND front face of buildings
front faces taller than side faces, side faces mostly hidden
cliffs show a bright top lip and a darker vertical face to read as height
objects overlap by Y-sorting (lower on screen = drawn in front)

lighting.type: soft daylight, no cast shadows from a hard sun
rules: light faces (top, left) use the lightest shade of the ramp
shadow faces (bottom, right) use the darkest shade of the ramp
small soft dark-ground blob under trees, buildings, and objects, 1-2 shades darker than the ground, never black
highlights shift toward yellow, shadows shift toward blue/teal/purple (hue shifting)
keep the same light direction for every asset

color.overall: warm, saturated, slightly yellowed greens, orange-gold ground, red roofs
color.shadow_rule: never darken by only lowering brightness; also shift hue toward cool (green->teal, orange->red-brown)

outlines.rule: outline color = very dark shade of the object's own material (dark brown for wood, dark green for trees, dark red for roofs), never black
outlines.inner_lines: avoid inner outlines; separate forms with shade changes instead
outlines.ground_tiles: no outline on terrain tiles; edges blend through transition tiles

materials.grass: base green with scattered 1-3px lighter blades, tiny flowers, occasional darker clumps; avoid flat fill
materials.dirt_path: orange-gold base with small pebbles (2-3px, slightly darker) and speckled lighter patches; organic edges, not straight lines
materials.water: light blue with short white/cyan ripple strokes, darker blue edge near banks, 2-4 frame loop animation
materials.wood: visible plank lines in a darker shade, lighter top edge, darker bottom edge
materials.roof: horizontal rows of shingles, each row has a light top edge and dark bottom edge, a bright ridge line
materials.cliff: bright grass lip on top, vertical face with 2-3 tone strata, darker at the base, small stones and roots
materials.trees: round clustered canopy built from 3-4 leaf-clump blobs, darker underside, light top-left, short visible trunk, vary species and size
materials.crops: 3-4 growth stages, bright saturated leaves, small colored fruit pixels, planted in tilled soil rows

composition_and_density.environment: dense and lived-in; fill empty space with small props
rules: avoid identical objects placed side by side; vary sprites, rotation, and spacing
paths and fields have organic, slightly irregular shapes
use clear silhouettes so every object is readable at small size
visual hierarchy: buildings and characters have the strongest contrast, terrain stays calmer
